quotes.text: We had a great trip this afternoon with Capt Chris! He was courteous, super knowledgeable, and patient with us rookie fishers. We had 3 adults and two children ages 13 and 10, and he was very helpful directing and teaching the kids what to do. We thoroughly enjoyed our 4 hours with him and would highly recommend his charters to both experienced and inexperienced fishers alike. Our trip was exactly as he advertised it would be!

Awesome day fishing today with Capt. Chris. My 2 sons their best friend and I caught a lot of fish. We did a 5 hours afternoon session and Chris made sure we were on the fish all afternoon. My youngest caught the most including a pretty big Cobia and some nice sized flounder. We will definitely go out with Capt. Chris again. Book him for your next fishing trip

The morning started out slow but Capt Chris found us the fish and my boys had a great time. Perfect for their first time saltwater fishing. Boat was very nice and clean and capt Chris was great helping out my boys (8 and 10)

Chris was amazing to work with. Going out with 4 kids he was accommodating to what we were looking for. He was wonderful with the kids and us two moms! We will definitely be calling him again next year! Thank you Chris!
We try to fish with captain Chris at least 2 times a year. He is a real captain he wants everyone to catch fish and he enjoys what he Is doing. If your in the area you should GO FISH with him.
We had a great time today with Captain Chris! The Captain put us on the fish! Captain Chris was very professional and excellent with the kids. Looking forward to booking with him next year!
